description: This file generates a sales pipeline chart by sales stage for a dashboard in the SugarCRM-based system. It includes logic for retrieving user preferences, date ranges, sales stages, and renders the chart with options for editing chart parameters. It also manages caching of chart images and handles user interaction for customization.

classes.name: jpgraph
classes.description: Class responsible for generating graph images, specifically for rendering the sales pipeline chart.

methods.name: pipeline_by_sales_stage
methods.description: Method that draws the sales pipeline chart based on provided data, date range, and user IDs.
